description.p: Glate is a fast desktop translator with built-in text to speech. Translate text between 100+ languages online through Google Translate, or use offline translation on your own computer, then listen to the result read aloud.

Offline mode uses Mozilla's Firefox translation models: download a language once and translate without internet, privately, because your text never leaves your device. No model ships with the app, so you only download the languages you need.

ul.li: Translate text between 100+ languages, with automatic language detection
Offline translation for nearly 60 languages with Mozilla's Firefox translation models, downloaded on demand (Pro)
An offline indicator shows when offline mode is on and which results were translated on your computer
Text to speech: read the text or its translation aloud, or only the part you select, with a choice of voice
Export speech to MP3, WAV, FLAC or AAC audio, with bitrate, sample rate and volume options
Line-by-line translation view to check long text sentence by sentence, with copy and read aloud for each line
Searchable translation history: load, copy or remove earlier translations
Share a translation by email or a paste link, or save it as a text file
Quick translate: select text in any app and translate it with a global keyboard shortcut
Stays in the system tray, with a choice between quitting and minimizing to the tray on close
Light and dark appearance that follows the system, Fusion and Fusion 2 themes, and your own accent colour
A short welcome for new users, keyboard shortcuts and What's new in the Help menu
Report a bug from the app, with the system details filled in for you
Interface in English, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian

description.p: A clearer app around the translator.

ul.li: See at a glance when offline mode is on, and which results were translated on your computer.
A new About window with credits, licences and diagnostics.
Report a bug from the Help menu, with the details filled in for you.
What's new opens once after each update.
A short welcome for new users instead of the slide show.
Offline translation no longer asks to upgrade when used right after start.

description.p: The Windows portable build is back.

ul.li: Glate builds on Windows again, including offline translation.

description.p: Offline translation, and Glate becomes open source under the GPL.

ul.li: New offline mode (Pro): translate on your own computer with Mozilla's Firefox translation models, so your text never leaves your device.
Download languages on demand from the new "Manage languages" dialog; nearly 60 languages are available, and pairs without English go through English.
Every downloaded model file is checked against its SHA-256 before it is used.
Glate is now free software under the GPL-3.0-or-later; the account and licence code is source-available.
Snap builds for both amd64 and arm64.
New store screenshots.

description.p: Theming defaults and custom title bar refinements.

ul.li: Fusion 2 is now the default skin for a cleaner, more modern look out of the box.
The app's own title bar (client-side decorations) now turns on automatically on GNOME/Wayland sessions, where the compositor draws no window controls of its own.
Improved the custom title bar's window border colour for better contrast against the desktop.
More reliable window interaction on the custom title bar, cleanly distinguishing move from edge/corner resize.
Settings now offer an explicit "On close" choice between quitting Glate and minimizing to the system tray.

description.p: Major UI, theming and localization update.

ul.li: Moved About out of Settings into a standalone dialog with direct toolbar access and quick project/developer links.
History list UI reworked for consistent row sizing, spacing and controls across Fusion and Fusion 2 themes.
Default skin switched to Fusion with a lighter default accent colour for better readability.
Fusion combo-box popups now use compact, scrollable height instead of expanding to full screen.
Added localization support for English, German, French, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian.
Added in-app language selector and startup locale loading from bundled translations.
Language and custom title bar (CSD) changes now show a restart prompt with “Restart Now” and “Restart Later”.
Updated toolbar/account/about icons and refreshed release metadata.

description.p: Audio export improvements and usability polish.

ul.li: Added read buttons in LineByLine mode
Advanced audio export options
Export dialog remembers the last used folder across sessions
Status messages simplified to remove internal technical terms

description.p: Major update with reworked UX, improved sharing, and single-instance enforcement.

ul.li: Single-instance enforcement: raising the existing window when app is launched again
History window overhauled: item selection, theming, and layout improvements
TTS buttons now disabled when source text is empty
Paste sharing now correctly handles UTF-8 text including CJK and Devanagari scripts
Plan comparison dialog shows Free, Evaluation, and Pro feature differences
Dark and light theme contrast improvements across dialogs
Snap packaging updated to core24 with CMake-based builds
Added Flatpak manifest and CI release artifacts
Aligned desktop metadata with reverse-DNS app ID for stores
